products.title: Perfumusk
products.body_html:
Musky • Oriental • Woody | مسكي • شرقي • خشبي

100 ml

Perfumusk Perfume is a rich musky woody fragrance with a warm fruity opening and a deep leathery character. It opens with saffron, dry fruits, galbanum, peach, blackcurrant, mandarin, bergamot and artemisia, creating a bright, aromatic and slightly sweet first impression.

At the heart, rose and osmanthus bring a soft floral elegance, while musk, cedar, patchouli, vetiver, green notes and leather add depth, freshness and a refined bold edge. The fragrance feels warm, smooth and confidently sophisticated.

The base settles into musk, amber, white woods, leather, sandalwood, moss, spicy notes and woody notes, creating a long-lasting trail that feels rich, elegant and powerful.
